verdicts.rationale: Provider adapters map the responses of different services onto the common observation shape. The steps look alike but read different fields and endpoints, and each service lives in its own directory so a change in one API touches one directory.

The plain OAuth flow replaces the refresh token only when the response has one and drops the state; the discovered flow also drops the PKCE verifier and keeps the previous refresh token. The two differ in what a credential must keep.
